entry.en: Your passport must have an expiry date at least 6 months after the date you arrive in Tuvalu.
entry.es: El pasaporte debe tener una fecha de vencimiento al menos 6 meses posterior a tu llegada a Tuvalu.
entry.quote: To enter Tuvalu, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

entry.en: To stay longer than one month, you must get an extension from the Department of Immigration in Funafuti.
entry.es: Para quedarte más de un mes debes obtener una prórroga del Departamento de Inmigración en Funafuti.
entry.quote: To stay longer than one month or to work, study, travel for business or other reasons, you must get an extension from the Department of Immigration in Funafuti.

entry.en: There are strict rules about goods you can take into or out of Tuvalu, and you must declare anything prohibited or subject to tax or duty.
entry.es: Hay normas estrictas sobre los bienes que se pueden llevar a Tuvalu o sacar de él, y debes declarar todo lo prohibido o sujeto a impuestos o aranceles.
entry.quote: There are strict rules about goods you can take into or out of Tuvalu. You must declare anything that may be prohibited or subject to tax or duty.

safety.en: It is illegal to import, export, cultivate or distribute drugs, with penalties including fines and imprisonment.
safety.es: Es ilegal importar, exportar, cultivar o distribuir drogas, con penas que incluyen multas y prisión.
safety.quote: It is illegal to import, export, cultivate or distribute drugs. Penalties include fines and imprisonment.

safety.en: Homosexuality is illegal in Tuvalu, and consensual sex between adult males could bring up to 14 years in prison.
safety.es: La homosexualidad es ilegal en Tuvalu, y las relaciones consentidas entre hombres adultos podrían acarrear hasta 14 años de prisión.
safety.quote: Homosexuality is illegal in Tuvalu. If you’re found guilty of consensual sex between adult males, you could face up to 14 years in prison.

safety.en: Take care when swimming, diving or snorkelling because sea currents can be extremely strong.
safety.es: Ten cuidado al nadar, bucear o hacer snorkel porque las corrientes del mar pueden ser extremadamente fuertes.
safety.quote: Take care when swimming, diving or snorkelling in the sea as currents can be extremely strong.

safety.en: Swimming in Funafuti lagoon is not recommended because it is highly polluted.
safety.es: No se recomienda nadar en la laguna de Funafuti porque está muy contaminada.
safety.quote: Swimming in Funafuti lagoon is not recommended as it is highly polluted.

safety.en: The tropical cyclone season normally runs from November to May, but cyclones can happen throughout the year.
safety.es: La temporada de ciclones tropicales suele ir de noviembre a mayo, pero pueden ocurrir durante todo el año.
safety.quote: The tropical cyclone season normally runs from November to May, but cyclones can happen throughout the year.

safety.en: Violent crime is rare in Tuvalu and usually involves alcohol and family disputes.
safety.es: El crimen violento es raro en Tuvalu y suele estar relacionado con el alcohol y disputas familiares.
safety.quote: Violent crime is rare, and usually involves alcohol and family disputes.

health.en: Drink or use only boiled or bottled water and avoid ice in drinks.
health.es: Bebe o usa solo agua hervida o embotellada y evita el hielo en las bebidas.
health.quote: Drink or use only boiled or bottled water and avoid ice in drinks.

health.en: Tuvalu's only hospital is on Funafuti, and trained nurses serve the outer islands.
health.es: El único hospital de Tuvalu está en Funafuti, y enfermeras capacitadas atienden las islas exteriores.
health.quote: Tuvalu’s only hospital is on Funafuti. Trained nurses serve the outer islands.

health.en: For serious or complicated problems you may need medical evacuation to Fiji or Australia.
health.es: Para problemas graves o complicados puede que necesites una evacuación médica a Fiyi o Australia.
health.quote: For more serious or complicated problems, you may need medical evacuation to Fiji or Australia.

health.en: Tap water quality is inconsistent and often collected from rooftops, so do not drink it without boiling or treating.
health.es: La calidad del agua del grifo es irregular y a menudo se recoge de los tejados, así que no la bebas sin hervirla o tratarla.
health.quote: Tap water quality is inconsistent at best; it's often collected from rooftops. Don't drink it without boiling or treating.

health.en: Check you have appropriate travel insurance for local treatment or unexpected medical evacuation.
health.es: Comprueba que tienes un seguro de viaje adecuado para tratamiento local o evacuación médica imprevista.
health.quote: you have appropriate travel insurance for local treatment or unexpected medical evacuation

help.en: Emergency numbers listed for Tuvalu include ambulance 999 and hospital (+688) 20749.
help.es: Los números de emergencia indicados para Tuvalu incluyen ambulancia 999 y hospital (+688) 20749.

getting_in.en: All international flights land at Funafuti International Airport on the capital atoll.
getting_in.es: Todos los vuelos internacionales aterrizan en el aeropuerto internacional de Funafuti, en el atolón capital.
getting_in.quote: all international flights land at Funafuti International Airport (FUN IATA) on the capital atoll.

getting_in.en: The primary gateway is Fiji, with regular flights from Nadi operated by Fiji Airways.
getting_in.es: La principal puerta de entrada es Fiyi, con vuelos regulares desde Nadi operados por Fiji Airways.
getting_in.quote: The primary gateway is Fiji, with regular flights from Nadi operated by Fiji Airways.

getting_in.en: Visiting yachts must clear formalities on arrival, with customs and immigration services near the main wharf.
getting_in.es: Los yates visitantes deben realizar los trámites a su llegada, con servicios de aduana e inmigración cerca del muelle principal.
getting_in.quote: Funafuti’s lagoon provides a safe anchorage with customs and immigration services available near the main wharf. Visiting yachts must clear formalities on arrival

getting_around.en: The main islet of Funafuti is easy to explore by motorbike, bicycle or on foot.
getting_around.es: El islote principal de Funafuti es fácil de recorrer en moto, bicicleta o a pie.
getting_around.quote: the main islet, Fongafale, is long and narrow, making it easy to explore by motorbike, bicycle, or on foot.

getting_around.en: Scooters and bikes are widely rented by guesthouses.
getting_around.es: Los alojamientos alquilan ampliamente scooters y bicicletas.
getting_around.quote: Scooters and bikes are widely rented by guesthouses

getting_around.en: Travel between the outer islands is by boat, as there are no domestic flights.
getting_around.es: Los viajes entre las islas exteriores se hacen en barco, ya que no hay vuelos nacionales.
getting_around.quote: Travel between the outer islands is done by boat, as there are no domestic flights.

getting_around.en: Government-run ferries and cargo vessels make scheduled trips several times a week, though timetables can shift with weather.
getting_around.es: Los ferris y cargueros estatales hacen viajes programados varias veces por semana, aunque los horarios pueden cambiar según el clima.
getting_around.quote: Government‑run ferries and cargo vessels make scheduled trips several times a week, though timetables can shift depending on weather and operational needs.

money.en: The currency of Tuvalu is the Australian dollar.
money.es: La moneda de Tuvalu es el dólar australiano.
money.quote: The currency of Tuvalu is the Australian dollar (ISO code: AUD)

money.en: There are no ATMs in Tuvalu and card payments are not accepted, so bring enough Australian dollars in cash for your trip.
money.es: No hay cajeros automáticos en Tuvalu y no se aceptan pagos con tarjeta, así que lleva suficientes dólares australianos en efectivo para el viaje.
money.quote: There are no ATMs in Tuvalu, and credit or debit card payments are not accepted. Bring enough Australian dollars in cash with you for the duration of your trip.

money.en: There are some ATMs in Funafuti but they work unreliably, so be ready to pay for everything with cash.
money.es: Hay algunos cajeros en Funafuti pero funcionan de forma inestable, así que prepárate para pagar todo en efectivo.
money.quote: Since it's not a good idea to rely on cards, be ready to pay for everything with cash

money.en: Exchanging currencies is possible but very unfavorable for visitors.
money.es: Es posible cambiar divisas, pero resulta muy desfavorable para los visitantes.
money.quote: It's possible to exchange currencies, but it's very unfavorable for visitors.

connectivity.en: There is one local mobile network in Tuvalu, other international networks will not work, and local SIM cards can be bought in Funafuti.
connectivity.es: Hay una sola red móvil local en Tuvalu, las demás redes internacionales no funcionan y se pueden comprar SIM locales en Funafuti.
connectivity.quote: There is one local mobile network in Tuvalu, other international networks will not work. You can buy local SIM cards in Funafuti.

connectivity.en: The international dialing code for Tuvalu is +688.
connectivity.es: El prefijo telefónico internacional de Tuvalu es +688.

connectivity.en: Tuvalu uses the Australia/New Zealand electrical plug with 240 volts and 50 Hz.
connectivity.es: Tuvalu usa el enchufe de Australia/Nueva Zelanda con 240 voltios y 50 Hz.
connectivity.quote: Tuvalu uses the Australia/New Zealand electrical plug with 240 volts and 50 Hz.
